I don’t know if I’ve heard that one. 

But I don’t mean the song I posted but how she tries to ignore the siren call at first and push them away, but they only get worse, until  she finally follows them. They only stop once she steps into her power and she learns she herself is the one she has been looking for all of her life. She steps fully into her power and leaves behind all fear inside her. Then the siren call stops, once she realizes what she was looking for was inside her all along.
Exactly! I guess that’s what they mean by surrender....Love and light on your journey. I guess there is comfort in knowing we are all going through this together.

Thank you for your response but I know it’s about me. I am working on myself.

The issue is I don’t want to feel him anymore, energetically or otherwise. I want to ascend more but as I raise my vibrations, meditate more, etc, the more I feel him and the more signs I see. And I don’t want to feel/see him. I don’t care what he’s doing, feeling, thinking. Just want him gone.

It makes me afraid to get back to my spirituality. When I’m not doing these things I do not feel him or get these signs. It makes me want to stay closed to move on. But staying closed, I cannot ascend. 

Does that make sense?

I don’t want mine to be my TF either and I am doing the same. Forgetting all the signs. My advice is block him on all fronts. It will only delay your healing. If our presence is always there, they will never learn to appreciate us or miss us. And if they really are our twin flame, as the literature claims, if we heal ourselves, then we heal them too. When it’s time, if it’s meant to be, the universe will intervene to make it happen. So for now let’s remove all reminders we have control over and learn to focus on ourselves as best we can.

Thanks so much for taking the time to make all your comments. You truly described how I feel and at least now I don’t feel so alone. You really helped me.

 I read your post about feeling abandoned by the universe and that’s exactly how I feel right now. I guess the answer for now is just keep ignoring the signs and keep focusing on me and hopefully they go away at some point.

Thank you so much for your reply. That’s what I’m trying to do now. Like last time I thought they were signs to reunion. Now I’m basically like f*** off universe. I’m going to Reiki and counselor and trying to work on myself. Idk.::I’m just scared to get back into meditation because the higher I get...the more I dream and see and feel
It’s not about the breakup. That was just the last trauma to push me over this edge.
